'''May 2001 Munich tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Munich, Germany on 19 May 2001. [[Quirin Fürgut]] won it. It is known from Quirin Fürgut's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2329">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-munich-ralltiir-5-19-01d2329/ munich-ralltiir-5-19-01], DeckTech (Quirin "el-diablo" Fuergut, 20 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-munich-ralltiir-5-19-01d2329/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Munich, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Quirin Fürgut]]
